_note: Real feed/dash/followingStates responses, captured live. This is the only source of follower_count: the legacy identity/profiles/{id}/networkinfo endpoint that published write-ups point at now answers 410 Gone, and the dash profiles resolve carries no following data at all (verified against a profile with showFollowerCount:true and eight figures of followers - its `included` bag holds the Profile entity and nothing else). Note the shape: a single entity bare on `data`, with `included` empty, unlike every collection section in this repo.

self._note: The session's own profile. followeeCount is populated here and null for third parties, which is what establishes that LinkedIn nulls individual fields in place rather than failing the request.

third_party._note: A public creator profile (showFollowerCount:true) fetched with someone else's session. Proves the count is readable for members other than the session owner.

withheld._note: SYNTHETIC, not captured. Models a member who hides their follower count (showFollowerCount:false seen from a third-party session) by nulling followerCount the way the real response nulls followeeCount above. Here so the withheld branch is covered; replace it with a real capture if one is ever observed.
